Name: mode
Comment: Locked to "img2vid" for this flow. Enables Wan-Fun image-to-video (or Wan 2.1 14B I2V 480P/720P). initImageBytes is REQUIRED; endImageBytes is ignored (that's flf2vid).

Name: files.diffusionModel
Comment: Path to the I2V transformer GGUF. Wan-Fun 1.3B: wan2.1-fun-i2v-1.3b-Q8_0.gguf. Wan 2.1 14B: wan2.1-i2v-14b-480p-Q8_0.gguf or wan2.1-i2v-14b-720p-Q8_0.gguf. MUST be an I2V variant -- a T2V GGUF here will silently produce garbage.

Name: files.highNoiseDiffusionModel
Comment: Optional. Path to Wan 2.2 MoE high-noise expert (I2V variant). Leave undefined for Wan 2.1 / Wan-Fun (single-expert).

Name: files.t5Xxl
Comment: Path to umt5-xxl encoder GGUF used by Wan. Reused from existing ctx.

Name: files.vae
Comment: Path to Wan VAE GGUF. Reused.

Name: initImageBytes
Comment: REQUIRED. Raw PNG/JPEG bytes for the seed (first) frame. Decoded via decodePng() and handed to sd_vid_gen_params_t::init_image. Resolution should match width x height (or it gets resized).

Name: endImageBytes
Comment: IGNORED for img2vid (flf2vid only). Leave undefined.

Name: controlFramesBytes
Comment: Optional VACE control frames (one Uint8Array per frame, in order). Empty / undefined disables VACE. Works alongside initImageBytes.

Name: videoFrames
Comment: Total output frames. Wan-Fun 1.3B sweet spot: 81 frames @ 16 fps == ~5 s. Must be (4*k + 1). Same constraint as txt2vid.

Name: fps
Comment: Output framerate written into the AVI container header only. Does NOT affect denoising. Default 16.

Name: strength
Comment: NEW for this flow (was reused). Denoising strength on the init image, [0, 1]. 1.0 = full re-noise (most motion / least adherence). 0.6-0.85 keeps the seed frame recognisable. Default 1.0.

Name: cfgScale
Comment: Text-prompt CFG. Wan I2V sweet spot: 5.0-6.5 (slightly lower than T2V). Default 5.0.

Name: imgCfg
Comment: NEW JS field. CFG scale on the image conditioning. Maps to sd_sample_params_t.guidance.img_cfg. Wan I2V default: 1.0-1.5; raise to push harder toward the seed frame.

Name: flowShift
Comment: Rectified-flow timestep shift. Wan I2V 480p = 3.0, Wan I2V 720p = 5.0, Wan-Fun 1.3B I2V = 3.0. Different from T2V (5.0-8.0). Wrong value -> dim/dark output.

Name: vaceStrength
Comment: VACE control strength in [0, 1]. 0 = ignore controlFramesBytes. Default 1.0 when control frames are provided.

Name: moeBoundary
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. Timestep boundary in [0, 1] at which sampling switches from low-noise to high-noise expert. Ignored if highNoiseDiffusionModel is unset. Default 0.875.

Name: highNoiseSampler
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. Same enum as sampler. Defaults to sampler when unset.

Name: highNoiseScheduler
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. Same enum as scheduler.

Name: highNoiseSteps
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. Step count for high-noise phase. 0 / unset = mirror steps.

Name: highNoiseCfgScale
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. CFG scale for high-noise phase. 0 / unset = mirror cfgScale.

Name: highNoiseFlowShift
Comment: Wan 2.2 MoE I2V only. flow_shift for high-noise phase. 0 / unset = mirror flowShift.

Name: videoCallback
Comment: Fires once when the AVI is fully encoded; receives a Uint8Array of MJPG-AVI bytes. Caller writes to disk or pipes to ffmpeg. Mutually exclusive with outputCallback.

Name: frameCallback
Comment: Optional per-frame PNG callback: (frameIdx, totalFrames, pngBytes) => void. Useful when the caller wants to assemble the video themselves (H.264 via ffmpeg, etc.).
